user.title: Severn Trent Water
user.description: Reuse an existing connection or enter an API key. Alternatively, paste the Authorization token from your signed-in Severn Trent browser session. A browser token regenerates your API key and may invalidate keys used elsewhere. Reuse a connection when adding another account.

account_selection.title: Select Account
account_selection.description: You have {num_accounts} Severn Trent accounts. Please select which one to monitor.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Severn Trent
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a valid API key or a fresh browser Authorization token. A browser token regenerates the key; other accounts sharing the old key here will also be updated after verification.

meter_selection.title: Select water meter
meter_selection.description: Select the meter to monitor for this account.

error.invalid_auth: Unable to authenticate with the API key
error.cannot_generate_api_key: Could not generate an API key from the browser token
error.no_accounts: No Severn Trent accounts found for this login
error.cannot_fetch_meters: Could not fetch meter information. Please contact support.
error.cannot_connect: Severn Trent is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.wrong_account: This login cannot access the configured account.
